verdict.rationale: A performance-mode toggle is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a power or performance mode setting. The closest items are a marketing line naming power users with high-performance hardware needs as an audience, and the Game Bar for recording and chats; neither is a toggle that boosts hardware performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can boost hardware performance on demand using a performance mode toggle
